definitions.explanation: The length of a garment's sleeve, measured from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff. A standard clothing measurement.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{袖丈|そでたけ}が{長|なが}い。
{袖丈|そでたけ}を{少|すこ}し{詰|つ}めてもらった。
examples.english: I had the sleeve length taken in a little.

examples.japanese: オーダーメイドのスーツでは、{肩幅|かたはば}や{袖丈|そでたけ}を{細|こま}かく{測|はか}る。
examples.english: For a tailor-made suit, they measure the shoulder width and sleeve length in detail.

notes:
The length of a sleeve, one of the basic measurements used when buying or altering clothes. Measured from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {袖丈|そでたけ}が{長|なが}い: the sleeves are long
- {袖丈|そでたけ}を{詰|つ}める: to shorten the sleeve length
- {袖丈|そでたけ}を{測|はか}る: to measure the sleeve length

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着丈|きたけ}: garment length — the length of the body of the garment
- {裄丈|ゆきたけ}: back-sleeve length — measured from the center back to the cuff, used for kimono and shirts
